posts.name: Julia
posts.cooked:
So, to recap (before this thread goes off the tracks and derails into another train pun one), the following people are up for this swap, although they may not yet know what to make (which is totally okay!):

Julia,  BlueHairedMeerkat, jagarciao, Silverleaf, Under3, Reckless, Imprimi5

We also have grysqrl and Theta_Sigma, who are up for it but can't do it in June and Donner who can paint Tactics minis (but unless he's got REALLY good connections needs to wait for Tactics). Oh, and phantaskippy, if you write a book of bad Sentinels poetry, you can totally join this swap. 

So it looks like we have enough interested people to do this, which is really cool!

So, further suggestions:

Schedule: I am thinking of starting a proper swap thread for this first ever sentinels craft swap on the 25th of May. Everybody who is willing to go through with this can register on there and I’ll do a blank questionnaire thingy (Favourite hero/Villain/environment/card, what you can produce craft wise, what item you might want to have, any crafts you are allergic to and maybe what continent you are on). After a week we partner people up and get crafting. Everybody sends their stuff of when they are ready (but check in on the forum first, in case someone’s partner flakes- man, I do not want that to happen) or on the 30th of June at the latest. Does that sound like a plan (a good one, I mean?)

Late swappers: If there is anybody who really wants to join in on the swap but can't craft in June due to life getting in the way, I think we can accommodate those people as long we can find them a partner who is up for a later swap (say, over the month of July). Also, if this does not wind up to be a frustrating mess for everybody, we can totally do another swap later in the year (in case someone needs a Fanatic Christmas Tree topper or something equally odd shudder).

Size: Are we going to put some constraints on the dimensions or complexity that a crafted item can have? For instance, we could say  each item has to fit into a particular parcel size, or we could say that no item should take more of two days of active crafting time. I am flexible on that, I just know that this is often done in swaps so nobody feels like they got the short end of the stick.

Opinions? Suggestions? More puns?

posts.name: Julia
posts.cooked:
I'm okay with allowing writing in the swap. I mean, it is indubitably a 'craft', it just tends not to be included in crafts swaps because these usually go for more haptic stuff. But if someone wants to swap for a Sentinels short story or some poetry or something, that is totally alright, I think. 

Also, let's make a rule here: Any crafted item is allowed in this swap as long as it is Sentinels themed, shippable (mail-shippable, not fandom-shippable!), non-hazardous and not likely to break the laws in either destination or origin country or the terms and conditions of the postal service.

So, you know, don't send working smoke bombs.

Or, well, anything, really…not fan-fiction, though - I don't like to write stuff which involves other people's characters doing stuff, any more than I'd want someone writing about one of my characters doing stuff, in case said character is described as doing/saying stuff they'd never normally do. But erm…like I said, I don't really think I could do anything else (other than crappy pictures) but I think it'd be nice to contribute something. I did have a sort of vague idea once for a Fantasy story (that being my thing) which is made almost entirely of Shout Outs to various Sentinels characters and stuff - like, character names and physical descriptions and stuff, and the reader(s) can then try and spot them all :D.

posts.name: Julia
posts.cooked:
Hi there, crafty people!

So the sign ups are now totally over. And we got 7 people taking part from all over the place, which is pretty cool, I think!

The only slight hitch is that we have an odd number of participants, which usually would mean that one person has to swap with two partners, one person has to drop out or that three participants have to do a swapping circle. All of those ideas aren't that great, so I've recruited another swapper... my mother?! Seriously though, she plays Sentinels and she makes knitted and crochet dolls. In fact, pretty much the only thing she can't handle is the internet, so I am going to do the communications for her and there goes that problem.

Now for the suggested partnering:

Julia <----> BlueHairedMeerkat  

Silverleaf <---->Theta_Sigma (swap will be delayed slightly to July)

Reckless<---  >Under3

Ghost<--- ->Julia's mum

This is the fairly international version. We could keep the swap more local, but I'm not sure if some people might not actually prefer swapping with someone in more exotic places! Also, I know that Reckless and Silverleaf were going to do a private swap of sorts, but you can still do that, right?

Anyway, does this sound reasonable to everybody, or does anybody want to swap partners?
